whyItMatters: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `environment` block that names no Flutter version.
actions: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix an `environment` block that names no Flutter version.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm pubspec.yaml no longer carries an `environment` block that names no Flutter version.
